Name: LeiAili's Revisions for Seasonal Outfits - Gil
Author: LeiAili
Description:
This mod revises Gil's portraits and sprites from the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url] so that his chair no longer changes color with the season. Now his outfit is the only thing that changes.

All credit for the original mod, portraits, and sprites goes to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2679113]Poltergeister[/url].

[b][size=3]YOU MUST INSTALL SEASONAL OUTFITS MOD FIRST IN ORDER FOR THIS MOD TO WORK.[/size]

[/b]
[size=5]Changes included:[/size]

[list]
[*]Updated the chair in Gil's portraits for spring, summer, fall, and winter, so it no longer changes with the season.
[/list]  
[size=5]Installation:[/size]
 [list]
[*][b]DO NOT USE A MOD MANAGER. [/b]Download mod manually and unzip.
[*]Copy the "assets" folder into the Seasonal Outfits mod folder (most likely C:\Program Files\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\[CP] Seasonal Cute Characters) and overwrite all changes.
[*]Run game as normal
[/list] 
 
Hope you enjoy my mod! Please feel free to comment if you have any feedback, or if something doesn't work. Thank you!
